posts.cooked:
Hey all,

Happy to be here!

Hopefully this is the right place to post this question: is there a comprehensive list of every Sentinels of the Multiverse crossover? I mean crossover in the sense that a character from Sentinels of the Multiverse has crossed over into another game.

Here's what I've gathered so far:

Bottom of the 9th - Almost the whole cast of SOTM
Lazer Ryderz - Visionary, Captain Cosmic, and maybe one other?
Dresden Files Card Game - Ra
Pixel Lincoln - The Freedom Five
One Deck Dungoen - Fanatic
Aeon's End - Nightmist
Arkham Horror - (Not a crossover in the truest sense but the Joe Diamond / Faye Diamond connection is worth mentioning)

Am I missing any?
